id./param/scenario/cs/b_040_cs_070.pack|cs_: "...A fitting end for a lowlife who covets others' things.
"Everyone! Are you hurt? I came with the feather people to save you!
"Son, how brave! We were only locked up, none of us is hurt. Thank you!
"...Travelers. Thank you for saving us. How can we ever repay you...
"Think nothing of it! Making everyone smile is my mission!
"No... Mum's necklace... it's broken. Dad will be so sad...
"It's the thought that counts! Even broken, Son's feelings will get through! He's your only family!
"The Parade of Smiles will see the villagers and Son home.
"I'll wait for you in the village. Ciao!"
